title: fix(cli): os doctor advises --verbose only when a warning has a fix for it to show
body:
Fixes #35454

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTyMahdAdhXSzgy2nt

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. 用户能看到什么变化：开发者在命令行做项目体检时，如果出现的警告都没有修复建议（例如缺少测试文件），结尾不再叫他打开详细模式重跑一次；有修复建议的警告照旧提示。
2. 为什么做：上一张修复 doctor 结尾提示的卡留下的另一半，开发者第一次用 CLI 时被引去重跑一次，却什么新内容也看不到。
3. 出错会怎样：最坏情况是某类有修复建议的警告不再带这句提示，警告本身和退出码都不变；撤回本 PR 即恢复原样。
4. 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts`: a new `hasVerboseOnlyFix` flag, tracked beside `hasWarnings`. The summary prints "Run with --verbose to see fix suggestions." only when `--verbose` is off AND that flag is set. Each warning path was read and classified:
  - sets the flag (a fix that only `--verbose` prints): an environment `HealthCheckResult` with `status === 'warning'` and a `fix`; a dashboard-widget warning with a non-empty `hint`; the config-load-failure finding when it carries a `fix`; any `--scan-deprecations` hit (its `replacement` is printed only under `--verbose`).
  - does not set it, no fix in either mode: missing tests, `@deprecated` usages, circular dependencies, unused objects, orphan views.
  - does not set it, fix already printed without the flag: the platform-protocol gap (its hint is printed unconditionally) and the isolated-posture unique-scope advisory (its prescription is printed unconditionally).
- The warnings' own text, the verdict line and exit codes are unchanged. No fix text was added.
- `.changeset/35454-doctor-verbose-hint-fixless.md`: patch, `@objectstack/cli`.

## Tests

- `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor-deprecation-hint-commands.test.ts`, in the existing `describe('the warnings summary')`, which uses the real `Doctor.run()`: a new case writes `packages/spec/src/a.zod.ts` with no test into the temp cwd and runs plain `os doctor`. It asserts that the "Missing test" warning fired, that the summary reached its warnings branch, and that the text after the verdict line does not name `--verbose`.
- The two existing cases from PR #35377 still cover the fix-bearing side: a `--scan-deprecations` warning still gets the hint without `--verbose` and gets none with it.

## Acceptance notes

- Dashboard-widget warnings whose `hint` is the empty string (`@objectstack/lint` emits `hint: ''` on one path) do not count as fix-bearing here, since `--verbose` would print only a bare arrow for them. That empty arrow line under `--verbose` is not changed here. Observation only, not reproduced at the public door.
- Environment rows with status `ok` also print their `fix` under `--verbose`. They are not warnings, so they do not count toward the hint. The behaviour is unchanged.

## Verification

Readings are at HEAD `d559e09a` (the fix commit `1dc43d70` merged with origin/main `f981dce3`; the merge brought in no package source).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit src/commands/doctor-deprecation-hint-commands.test.ts`. Expected: 15 passed.

Read first: `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts`, the summary's `if (!flags.verbose && hasVerboseOnlyFix)` and the four places that set the flag. The risk is a fix-bearing path left unclassified.

- At `86ec0951` (the new pin on an unmodified `doctor.ts`): Tests 1 failed, 14 passed (15). The new case failed with `expected '\n   Run with --verbose to see fix su…' not to contain '--verbose'`.

</details>

- Restore: the blob after restore equals HEAD (975d2c65) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
